actions: Derived a pathwise decision-sufficiency theorem for paired binary evaluation.
Proved that oriented ternary discordance Z in {-1,0,+1} is the minimal reusable per-task exact verifier contract for the current sign/e-process/McNemar policy class.
Separated full-output, binary-pair, sign-statistic, and terminal aggregate verification contracts and derived rollback mismatch identities r_sign <= r_bits <= r_raw.
Extended the contract boundary to stateful agents and stochastic scorers through observer-closure requirements.
Persisted a new role-local checkpoint and advanced LATEST with CAS/readback discipline.
Recorded an operational repository-hygiene defect caused by an accidental noop branch creation during connector discovery.

repository_hygiene_incident.repair_attempt: Read-only connector discovery found no branch/ref deletion action; no further mutation was attempted.
repository_hygiene_incident.required_followup: Delete the unintended branch only through an explicitly available safe branch-deletion control path; do not use it for any work.

termination.cause: invocation response boundary after durable checkpoint/readback
termination.exact_next_action: Construct a small public benchmark that measures raw-output, binary-pair, and oriented-sign mismatch rates under repeated inference with a frozen deterministic scorer, then compare full-output rollback to exact-sign rollback and separately measure verifier runtime.
